equity.level_reason: Unsheltered homelessness (SES/housing) defines the population of a six-case series; no group-specific results or contrasts are reported.

level_alternative.reason: Homelessness and limited access to hygiene facilities and health care are discussed as explanations, which could count as equity raised beyond defining the population.

determinants_of_health.v: limited access to hygiene facilities; unsheltered homelessness

ev.q: homelessness is the principal risk factor for B. quintana infection ( 2 ), likely attributable to limited access to hygiene facilities ( 1 ).

equity.equity_measurement: Housing status taken from the medical record or the NYC DHS system; all six cases had unsheltered homelessness, so there is no comparison group.

notes: Case finding by retrospective laboratory surveillance and the PCR/sequencing diagnostics are design steps, not procedures. The determinant is cited from earlier literature in the introduction as the explanation for homelessness as a risk factor.
view_issues: Text says five patients had a documented mental health or substance use disorder; the Table lists history of mental health condition 3 (50%) and alcohol use 5 (83%), so the text figure combines them.
